scope: Audit accuracy of resolved=true flag on 721/817 concerns
method: Random stratified sample (seed=42) of 10 per _extraction_policy bucket; judged author_response addresses concern_text from text alone.

verdict_definitions.VERIFIED_RESOLVED: Author response describes a concrete change/addition that addresses the concern.
verdict_definitions.PARTIAL: Response addresses some but not all aspects of the concern.
verdict_definitions.ACKNOWLEDGED_NOT_FIXED: Response acknowledges without describing a concrete change.
verdict_definitions.DEFLECTED: Response punts to scope/future work without a fix.
verdict_definitions.UNCLEAR: Response too vague (e.g. 'addressed in revision') to judge.

egregious_misclassifications.issue: Authors explicitly DECLINED to change the abstract citing word limits, yet resolved=true. The concern asked the abstract be updated to mention observed TB outcome; this did not happen.
Reviewer raised a substantive design-vs-analysis inconsistency. Response merely says authors 'clarified the conceptual flow' — no concrete change described; resolution status should be null/false.

Response 'Addressed in revision.' has no extractable content. The concern is HIGH severity (label validity for 2.2M ECGs + image-format coverage). Marking resolved=true on a 4-word non-response is the riskiest pattern for RAG hallucination.
Same pattern as PR-073-C02: 'Addressed comorbidity handling in revision' is non-information; cannot support a resolved=true claim.
Authors added confirmatory-pathway discussion but explicitly deferred cost-effectiveness analysis (a core part of the ask). Acceptable as PARTIAL but worth flagging as a candidate for resolved=null.

recommendation: On this 30-concern sample, 26/30 (87%) of resolved=true entries describe a real fix (VERIFIED_RESOLVED=22 or PARTIAL=4). Extrapolating to the full 721 resolved=true population (95% Wilson CI roughly 70-95%), we estimate ~505-685 are reasonably accurate and ~36-216 (5-30%) are mislabeled — primarily ACKNOWLEDGED_NOT_FIXED, DEFLECTED, or UNCLEAR. The dominant failure mode is the vague non-response ('Addressed in revision.', 'authors clarified ...') which should be retagged resolved=null. Recommend a targeted lint: any author_response shorter than ~80 characters OR matching the regex r'^(addressed|clarified|noted|added discussion)' without further substance should be downgraded to resolved=null pending manual review. Estimate this rule would flag ~50-100 of the 721 entries. Accuracy is acceptable for RAG with retrieval-time grounding (the model sees the actual author_response text) but the resolved flag itself should not be trusted as a hard filter.
